svg.title: morgue — a drawer of clippings for motion on the web
svg.desc: An exploded view of the morgue vault: a browser window showing a searchable grid of captured UI animations, with a lifted preview card, a capture log reading "motion: OK", a 24-frame contact sheet, and an agent-ready export bundle floating off its surface.

g.text: Hand it a component. It captures a deterministic
video preview, files it under a controlled
vocabulary, and writes down how it works.
the one where the panels pin and scroll sideways
video on hover · never live code
